candidates.name: Apptainer

candidates.name: Container Device Interface (CDI)

candidates.name: containerd
candidates.why_candidate: Container runtime used by rootless nerdctl stacks and supporting CDI device configuration ([README](https://github.com/containerd/containerd/blob/main/README.md), [CDI integration](https://github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/blob/main/README.md#containerd-configuration)); latest release [v2.4.1](https://github.com/containerd/containerd/releases/tag/v2.4.1), 2026-09-24.

candidates.name: crun

candidates.name: libnvidia-container
candidates.why_candidate: Library and CLI for configuring Linux containers to access NVIDIA hardware ([README](https://github.com/NVIDIA/libnvidia-container/blob/main/README.md)); latest release [v1.20.1](https://github.com/NVIDIA/libnvidia-container/releases/tag/v1.20.1), 2026-09-28.

candidates.name: Moby (Docker Engine)
candidates.why_candidate: Docker Engine’s upstream container platform, with CDI device support ([README](https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/master/README.md), [CDI integration](https://github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/blob/main/README.md#docker-and-podman-configuration)); latest release [docker-v29.8.2](https://github.com/moby/moby/releases/tag/docker-v29.8.2), 2026-09-30.

candidates.name: nerdctl
candidates.why_candidate: Docker-compatible CLI supporting rootless containerd and Linux containers on WSL2 ([README](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/blob/main/README.md)); latest release [v2.4.0](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/releases/tag/v2.4.0), 2026-09-20.

candidates.name: Podman CDI

candidates.name: runc

candidates.name: SingularityCE
candidates.why_candidate: Linux application container platform with host GPU integration ([README](https://github.com/sylabs/singularity/blob/main/README.md)); latest release [v4.5.1](https://github.com/sylabs/singularity/releases/tag/v4.5.1), 2026-08-20.

search_notes: Alphabetical and unranked. Checked on 2026-10-01 America/New_York (2026-10-02 UTC): every repository listed is public, not archived, and has a latest stable release within 90 days, verified using the required gh api repository and releases/latest endpoints plus its README. GitHub resolves the Podman seed to the canonical repository shown. Runtime, library, and CDI entries are complementary components of GPU-enabled stacks and require NVIDIA device/library configuration. Apptainer and SingularityCE are conditional candidates: their upstream Linux GPU integration is documented, but WSL2-specific GPU operation was not established from the retrieved sources. NVIDIA passthrough eligibility concerns the primary WSL2 host; Apple GPU access on macOS arm64 was not established. No additional component is conditional on CPU-only workloads; the supplied host description does not establish that its containers need no GPU. Enroot was excluded because its [latest release](https://github.com/NVIDIA/enroot/releases/tag/v4.2.1) dates to 2026-06-09 and its [default-branch commit](https://github.com/NVIDIA/enroot/commit/ead3a25ed974) to 2026-05-19. Used 30 GitHub API calls, six search queries, and eight direct page-fetch attempts. Some search and documentation retrievals failed, so exhaustive discovery could not be established.
